name: backup-notes
description: Export the user's memory store to a timestamped backup file.
steps: export memories to JSON via the memory store
write to backup_directory with a timestamped filename
report file path, record count, and size
validation: backup file exists and record count matches the store
failure_recovery: retry once, then report the error with free-space hint
cautions: backups contain private data: keep them on local disk only
never upload, email, or sync backup files anywhere
never include secrets verbatim in progress output
